## [*Six energies, one dataset.*]{.shimmer}

We took our name from Manifest's *"Arıyo"*, six of us, each carrying a member's energy into the project.

> Each of us is paired with one Manifest member whose vibe matches the role we played in this project. Click the names to visit our personal EMU430 pages.

[Hilal · the leader's poise]{.alter-ego}

[Project leadCoordination]{.role}

Işıl held the project together, from initial dataset selection through final-page polish. If something needed deciding, Işıl decided it; if a deadline was approaching, Işıl was already three days ahead. Calm, systematic, and impossible to fluster.
